description: Chief Ministry Western Province - The Administration of Local Authorities Statute 2019
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a new provincial statute ("Administration of Local Authorities Statute") that establishes legal provisions for the administration and supervision of local authorities in the Western Province. It outlines regulatory powers, investigation procedures, and penalties for non-compliance, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the Chief Minister and his portfolios is incidental to the main purpose of publishing the statute.
